integrity: Every general claim is supported by a self-contained analytic proof; finite rational and independent linear-program/matrix tests are separated from theorem-level verification. This package has not received independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns entrywise-nonnegative degree-two Laplacian polynomial kernels on unweighted K_{p,q}, not unrestricted two-hop Markov matrices. The classical unconstrained polynomial optimum accounts for the feasible first branch. Literature search cannot exclude unindexed equivalent specializations; finite code checks are not a proof.
title: Sharp positivity transition for quadratic fastest-mixing kernels on complete bipartite graphs
